  fi

[Sat 2026-05-09 05:15 UTC] Combine the configuration files and network data into a single package.

arguments.command:
bash -lc "pkg='/root/.openclaw/workspace/vpn_net_package_2026-05-09_0515UTC.tar.gz'
cd /root/.openclaw/workspace
# Include ARP cache and a copy of routing/interface snapshots from /proc
mkdir -p package_tmp
cp -f arp_cache.txt package_tmp/ 2>/dev/null || true
cp -f /proc/net/route package_tmp/proc_net_route.txt 2>/dev/null || true
cp -f /proc/net/dev package_tmp/proc_net_dev.txt 2>/dev/null || true
cp -f /proc/net/arp package_tmp/proc_net_arp.txt 2>/dev/null || true
# Include any discovered VPN configs (none found earlier, but re-scan and include if present)
find /etc -maxdepth 4 \( -path '*/openvpn*' -o -path '*/vpn*' -o -path '*/NetworkManager/system-connections*' \) -type f \( -iname '*.ovpn' -o -iname '*.conf' \) -print 2>/dev/null > package_tmp/vpn_config_paths.txt || true
# Copy those files into package_tmp/vpn_configs/ preserving paths
mkdir -p package_tmp/vpn_configs
while IFS= read -r f; do
  [ -n "$f" ] || continue
  dest="package_tmp/vpn_configs${f}"
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$dest")"
  cp -f -- "$f" "$dest" 2>/dev/null || true
done < package_tmp/vpn_config_paths.txt

tar -czf "$pkg" -C package_tmp .
rm -rf package_tmp
ls -l "$pkg""
